get.description: Returns the consolidated detail of all investment applications across the available application types (committed, fund, deposit, COE). Supports filtering by application type, date range, account, link, investment and institution. Results are paginated.

applicationType.description: Application type: one of COMMITTED, FUND, DEPOSIT, COE.

investmentId.description: Identifier of the investment that this application belongs to.

grossBalance.description: Gross balance of the application before taxes.

netBalance.description: Net balance of the application after taxes.

parameters.name: applicationType
parameters.description: Application type to filter by. Can be repeated to include multiple types. Defaults to all four types.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the application date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the application date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Filter by one or more account IDs. Can be repeated.

parameters.name: linkId
parameters.description: Filter by one or more link IDs. Can be repeated.

parameters.name: investmentId
parameters.description: Filter by one or more investment IDs. Can be repeated.

parameters.name: institutionId
parameters.description: Filter by one or more institution IDs. Can be repeated.
